name: Find and recommend cloud hosting and server services
description: Users sought recommendations for cloud infrastructure, hosting providers, and virtual private server options, including free tiers, specific hardware configurations, and managed services for deploying applications. Many requests focused on identifying services that allow running scripts, bots, or websites, while others inquired about billing models, performance metrics, or connectivity solutions like VPNs to access specific servers.
